notes: Download Excel lists every device and every past test, ordered by customer, address, device, and test date.
Tapping Update stores a flag so the notes stay quiet after reload. This release can still show the notes twice. The following release will not.
Save Draft turns green and says Draft Saved, then returns to normal. Cancel Job asks before it cancels.
Buttons shrink and darken when pressed. Saves, sends, and similar actions confirm with a green label or a short note.
